stop_reason: No exercise contrast in the sequenced samples. GSE165110 contains only C2C12 myotubes treated 24 h with 4% STEM secretome vs 4% horse serum (6 vs 6). The paper's in vivo manipulations are hindlimb unloading (disuse) and 7-day ambulatory recovery, not exercise, and those mice were not sequenced. A STEM-vs-serum contrast in cultured cells cannot estimate how exercise affects gene expression.
